question: If you catch malaria, how do you smell to mosquitoes?
answer: The malaria parasite changes your body chemistry, so you give off a smell that draws mosquitoes. That makes you more attractive to them, and the mosquitoes carry the parasite on to the next person.
move: Malaria makes you smell better to the very mosquitoes that spread it.

web.label: Asks how a person with malaria smells to mosquitoes, with three choices: they keep away, they stay the same, or they flock to you. The reader picks one, then watches the mosquitoes.

source: Veritasium, “Why Mosquitoes Bite Some People More Than Others” (YouTube, 2018)
